decisions.open_point: Dynamic aliasing in openrouter/free causes inconsistent model evaluation baselines
decisions.decision: Tag dynamic model_actual rows with low_confidence and exclude them from quality baseline aggregations
decisions.rationale: Dynamic routing changes underlying models unpredictably, skewing quality metrics if included in standard evaluations

decisions.open_point: OpenRouter 402 token limit rejections on large prompt requests
decisions.decision: Enforce explicit max_tokens on all OpenRouter requests and treat 402 as permanent needs_credit status
decisions.rationale: Prevents redundant retries and quota burn when account credit or token tier limits are reached
